title: Nice to meet you
scene: It is Anna's first week at college in Kyiv. At a party for new students a speaker says 'Ladies and gentlemen, welcome!' to all the people; Anna says hello to Max - 'Nice to meet you!' - a student from her college, and by the end of the cool party they are good friends.

I am a student.
Welcome to our home!
How many people are here?
Hello, how are you?
Nice to meet you.

Is this cafe good?

Hey amigo, how are you doing?
I met my old army comrades last summer.

old_story: It is Anna's first week at [[college]] in Kyiv. Tonight there is a [[party]] for new [[students|student]]. A man says, "[[Ladies|lady]] and [[gentlemen|gentleman]], [[welcome]]!" Many [[people]] smile and clap. Anna sees a tall boy alone. She says, "[[Hello|hello]]! I am Anna." He says, "I am Max. [[Nice|nice]] to meet you!" They dance and laugh all night. The music is [[cool]], and the food is [[good]]. At the end, Anna and Max are [[friends|friend]].

title: Lost on the first day
scene: Anna is late and in trouble on her first day. A guard says 'Your ID, please', she answers 'Sorry, sir, one moment', and a kind Miss at the desk says the room is easy to find - 'OK, thank you!'

old_story: Anna is late on her first day. At the door, she is in [[trouble]]. A guard says, "Your [[ID]], [[please]]." Anna opens her bag and says, "[[Sorry|sorry]], [[sir]]. One [[moment]]." Then she cannot find room twelve. She asks a woman at the desk, "Excuse me, [[Miss]], where is it?" The woman smiles. "It is [[easy]]. Go up and left." Anna says, "[[OK]], thank you!" She gets to class just in time.

title: Lunch at the café
scene: Anna and Max have lunch at a small café near college. They read the menu: Max orders soup and a sandwich, Anna takes a salad with dressing and chicken with rice and sauce, and for dessert she wants tea with lemon.

old_story: Anna and Max have [[lunch]] at a small [[cafe]]. It is near their college. They read the [[menu]]. Max orders [[soup]] and a [[sandwich]]. Anna wants a salad with [[dressing]]. She also takes chicken with [[rice]] and [[sauce]]. The food is hot and very tasty. For [[dessert]], Anna has cake and [[lemon]] tea. Max eats half of her cake!

title: Coffee before class
scene: Max meets Anna at a coffee shop with a great vibe, full of hipsters with laptops. The barista makes a latte from a new blend and a cappuccino with caramel - Max is a real coffee snob - and they take a croissant and a muffin.

old_story: Max meets Anna at a [[coffee shop]] before class. The place has a great [[vibe]]. It is full of [[hipsters|hipster]] with laptops. The [[barista]] makes Anna a [[latte]]. It is from a new [[blend]]. Max orders a [[cappuccino]] with [[caramel]]. He tastes it slowly and nods. Anna laughs. "You are a real coffee [[snob]]!" They also take a [[croissant]] and a [[muffin]]. Then they run to class, cups in hand.

title: Pizza night
scene: Max wants to chill at home with friends and watch a movie. They order a big pizza for delivery and choose the toppings, pepperoni and mozzarella - the diameter is forty centimeters - get cola, nachos and other snacks, and make popcorn.

old_story: On Friday, Max wants to [[chill]] at home. Anna and two friends come over. They order a big [[pizza]] for [[delivery]]. "What [[topping]] do we want?" asks Anna. "[[Pepperoni|pepperoni]] and [[mozzarella]]!" says Max. It is huge, with a [[diameter]] of forty centimeters. They also get [[cola]], [[nachos]], and other [[snacks|snack]]. Then Max makes [[popcorn]], and they watch a movie. Soon everybody is asleep on the sofa.
